fixtures.purpose: Complete, well-evidenced investigation in professional language with ATT&CK tags. Upper anchor.

timeline.author: Student 1
timeline.body: Phishing email to j.cohen on WS03 with attachment Invoice_Q3.docm. Mail gateway shows it was opened at 08:41 and Word ran a macro.

timeline.author: Student 2
timeline.body: WS03: winword.exe spawned powershell.exe -enc ...; the decoded command downloads a payload from 203.0.113.50.

timeline.author: Student 1
timeline.body: WS03: the downloaded tool read LSASS memory at about 09:00, so credentials were dumped. svc_backup is the likely stolen account.

timeline.author: Student 3
timeline.body: FS01: logon of svc_backup from WS03 at 09:12, followed by encoded PowerShell. Lateral movement with the stolen credentials.

timeline.author: Student 2
timeline.body: FS01: C:\ProgramData\stage.zip created at 09:40 and about 2 GB sent over HTTPS to an external IP right after, so data was exfiltrated.

timeline.author: Student 3
timeline.body: Root cause: the phishing macro on WS03. VPN brute force ruled out: no failed VPN logons in the window.
